name: DIFC + ADGM Digital Asset Frameworks — DFSA Crypto Tokens + FSRA Digital Asset Framework (2025)
reference: DFSA Crypto Token regime + ADGM FSRA Digital Asset Framework (amended 10 June 2025)

chapters.title: ADGM FSRA Digital Asset framework (amended 10 Jun 2025)

articles.title: DFSA Crypto Token scope
articles.requirement: Captures DIFC-licensed firms providing services relating to Recognised Crypto Tokens (DFSA-recognised tokens) + Security Tokens. Activities: dealing as principal / agent, arranging deals, advising, managing assets, providing custody, operating an exchange or alternative trading system.

articles.title: DFSA authorisation
articles.requirement: Crypto-token activities require an additional endorsement to a DFSA licence; fit-and-proper criteria; capital + organisational + governance requirements proportionate to scale; technology-risk + cybersecurity framework. High approval bar — DFSA has issued a deliberately limited number of crypto endorsements.

articles.title: DFSA custody of crypto tokens
articles.section: DFSA CTKN module + DIFC Investment Trust rules
articles.requirement: Customer-asset segregation; insolvency-remote arrangements; cold + hot wallet architecture proportionate to risk; key-management standards (MPC, HSM, multi-sig); independent assurance over custody arrangements; reporting customer-asset balances to DFSA. Alignment with international custody standards + IOSCO crypto standards.

articles.title: DFSA AML alignment
articles.requirement: DIFC AML rules under DFSA AML Module substantially aligned with FATF + FDL 10/2025. CDD + EDD + PEPs + SAR + sanctions screening. SARs filed to FIU UAE via goAML (DIFC firms still subject to federal SAR obligations). Tipping-off prohibition. Risk-based approach.

articles.title: ADGM FSRA Digital Asset scope
articles.requirement: Captures ADGM-licensed firms providing digital-asset services: trading + custody + arranging + advising + managing. Distinct from federal CBUAE / SCA + DIFC DFSA + Dubai VARA scope. ADGM operates as a separate common-law jurisdiction with its own courts.

articles.title: ADGM notification-based regime (amended 10 June 2025)
articles.section: ADGM FSRA Digital Asset Framework (June 2025 amendment)
articles.requirement: June 2025 amendment introduced a notification-based regime for certain established digital-asset activities — faster market entry for firms already licensed in equivalent jurisdictions with substance + governance demonstrably equivalent to FSRA standards. Maintained a full authorisation track for novel or higher-risk activities. Reflects ADGM's strategic push to attract crypto firms exiting other jurisdictions.

articles.title: ADGM prohibitions (June 2025 amendment)
articles.section: ADGM FSRA Digital Asset Framework (June 2025 amendment)
articles.requirement: Express prohibitions on: privacy tokens (Monero, Zcash, similar); algorithmic stablecoins (post-Terra collapse). Aligned with VARA prohibitions. Existing licensees with these exposures had transition windows to exit. Periodic review of the prohibited-token list.

articles.title: ADGM custody of digital assets (tightened June 2025)
articles.section: ADGM FSRA Digital Asset Framework — Custody
articles.requirement: Customer-asset segregation; insolvency-remote arrangements; cold-wallet majority + multi-party computation (MPC) or HSM-based hot wallets; key-management standards; independent assurance; reporting customer-asset balances to FSRA. June 2025 amendment tightened: stricter MPC / multi-sig expectations + clearer accountability for key-holders + scenario testing requirements.

articles.title: ADGM AML alignment
articles.requirement: ADGM AML rules substantially aligned with FATF + FDL 10/2025. CDD + EDD + PEPs + SAR + sanctions screening. SARs filed to FIU UAE via goAML; ADGM firms remain subject to federal SAR obligations. Tipping-off prohibition. Risk-based approach. ADGM Office of Data Protection coordination for personal-data dimensions of AML CDD.

articles.title: ADGM market conduct rules
articles.requirement: Anti-market-manipulation rules; surveillance + reporting of suspicious orders + transactions; insider-dealing prohibition; appropriate-customer-categorisation (retail / professional / institutional); KIDs / disclosures + suitability rules for retail-facing services.

articles.title: DIFC + ADGM coordination + comparison
articles.requirement: DIFC DFSA + ADGM FSRA digital-asset regimes are substantially aligned in substance (FATF + IOSCO + Travel Rule + custody standards) but distinct in process: DFSA endorsement-based, lower approval volume; FSRA more recently moving to notification-based for established firms, larger licensee population. Cross-licensee firms (operating in both DIFC + ADGM) must comply with both rulebooks simultaneously.
